entities.summary: The transborder waterfall complex remains one of North America’s highest-impact natural sights, with enough scale and sensory force to justify itinerary changes.
entities.description: This entity is the physical Niagara Falls complex—Horseshoe, American and Bridal Veil Falls—not the municipality or surrounding commercial attractions. The Canadian and U.S. sides offer complementary upper, gorge and close-up perspectives.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The combination of extraordinary flow, accessible major viewpoints and multiple perspectives reliably produces trip-highlight behavior even after discounting fame and tourist infrastructure.

entities.summary: Toronto’s defining communications tower delivers a genuinely high-quality observation experience when visibility cooperates.
entities.description: The main observation levels combine 346-metre city-and-lake views with the tower’s unusual structural presence and glass-floor elements. Optional EdgeWalk is a separate thrill product; the A-tier judgement does not depend on purchasing it.
entities.whyWorthwhile: On a clear day, the vertical scale and broad Lake Ontario/Toronto panorama make this more than a photo of an iconic skyline landmark.

names.canonical: Niagara Parks Power Station + The Tunnel

entities.summary: A restored 1905 hydroelectric station whose 600-metre tailrace tunnel leads to a dramatic river-level portal below Niagara Falls.
entities.description: The supplied Tunnel identity is operationally inseparable from Niagara Parks Power Station: regular admission enters through the station, descends roughly 55 m by elevator and continues through the historic tailrace tunnel. Modelling the ticketed station-plus-tunnel unit preserves the saved experience without pretending the tunnel is a separately bookable attraction.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The combination of huge preserved generating machinery, interpretation and the long tunnel to the gorge creates one of Niagara’s strongest non-waterfall attractions.

names.canonical: Saint Joseph's Oratory of Mount Royal

entities.summary: Montréal’s monumental hillside Catholic shrine combines pilgrimage history, distinctive interiors and broad city views.
entities.description: The Oratory is more than a dome seen from afar: visitors move through the crypt church, basilica, devotional spaces and terraces across a large multilevel complex. The strongest visit combines architecture and Brother André pilgrimage history with the elevated setting.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The mix of monumental scale, unusual religious history and terrace views is strong enough to justify a deliberate cross-city visit.

entities.summary: A free Victorian greenhouse complex offering a compact but consistently rewarding tropical-and-arid plant escape in central Toronto.
entities.description: Five greenhouse zones create a dense sequence of palms, tropical foliage, orchids, succulents, cacti and seasonal displays. The value is quality-per-effort rather than scale.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Free admission, year-round warmth and well-kept collections make it an easy deliberate choice when nearby or when Toronto weather is poor.

entities.summary: A small Bracebridge artisan bakery with unusually consistent local praise for sourdough, croissants and pastry.
entities.description: Big River is a bakery rather than a destination restaurant. Its publication case is the current Goodshit C-tier food rule: it is a deliberate, evidence-backed choice for someone already in Bracebridge or Muskoka, with strong repeat praise for the core baked goods.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The bread and laminated pastry are good enough that a traveler in the neighborhood has a clear reason to choose this bakery over generic alternatives.

entities.summary: A compact central Ottawa park whose real strength is its easy Parliament, Rideau Locks and river panorama.
entities.description: Major's Hill Park is a small but unusually well-sited public landscape between major downtown attractions. Lawns, mature trees and short paths provide a genuine decompression stop rather than just a map pin.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The combination of free access, exceptional central location and multiple landmark sightlines makes it clearly worthwhile when nearby.
